scope: Partial source-assisted weak labels, not exhaustive independently human-corrected truth.
Rejected initial delegated annotations were excluded from every training run recorded here.
255 means unreviewed; precision/counts cover reviewed pixels only.
All trials trained segmentation only; none has a freshly trained production light-center head.
Color shifts reuse the same layouts and labels; they are not an independent art-style test.
No candidate was evaluated on the four reserved test layouts.
The source corpus contains 31 canonical layouts and 31 WebP derivatives, deduplicated by layout.
No compression was used for datasets, logs or checkpoints.

mothveil_geometry_erratum.description: The window span covers the full framed opening and rays cross both exported faces. Old short rays ended inside the assembly. Only geometry checks changed; historical training datasets are preserved and did not use geometry selection.

trials.reason: Seed: no extracted Mothveil doors/windows; false terrain walls and older-style regressions.
Expanded real seed: almost no glass, no usable fence crossing and older-map regressions.
Replay plus one adaptable block: no glass, failed fence movement and older-map wall recall loss.
Synthetic curriculum: Mothveil door missed, Rimebell fence missed, stricter-runtime recolored window missed and older-map regressions.
Real-only continuation: glass and older-map performance deteriorated; no Mothveil door/window or usable Rimebell fence.

measurement_notes: Each inference report includes first inference plus three synchronized warm runs. Local GPU/CPU load was not isolated; do not infer a speedup from these timings.
The common 0.9 cutoff applies to all pixel classes. Geometry-thresholds profile preserves runtime per-class cutoffs: windows 0.93 and fences 0.97 by default.

After inference runs, CLI preview/report support and public UVTT marker handling were completed. All 40 cached cases were rechecked against the final geometry code; geometry counts, span matches and passage results were identical. New exported-face previews were generated for Mothveil runtime checks.
The five additional floor/terrain/frame regression rays were selected after reviewing validation failures. They are not independent test data and are not training labels.
A blocked closed-door ray alone does not establish door detection; check door-span matches.
Foundry 14.369 native schema fixture passed offline. Live-world visibility and proximity behavior were not exercised.
